fields.Name: T109 - Category-Scoped New Query
fields.Description: Exercises the OpenCreateDrawer(categoryID) branch that pre-seeds DrawerCategoryID from the clicked folder — a distinct code path from the header '+' which opens a blank/active-category drawer.

InputDefinition.goal: Assume you are already logged in at http://localhost:4200. Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo, switch to Data Explorer, and open the Queries section. Hover over a specific category folder header in the tree — a small '+' (New query in <category>) button appears on the category row. Click it. Success is the New Query drawer opening with that folder's Category already pre-selected in the Category dropdown (so a query created here would land in that folder). You do NOT need to save. If create permission is absent the per-category '+' button will not appear; report that outcome. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: Hovering a category folder reveals a per-category '+' add button, and clicking it opens the New Query drawer
The drawer's Category selector is pre-populated with the category the '+' was clicked in
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages, OR the per-category '+' is legitimately absent due to permissions
